name: RAPPid Zoo — Ten Summons
tagline: Ten prompts that prove every AI on a machine is a creature with a call. Card-only: no media files, every claim runnable verbatim against kody-w/rappid.
_note: This repo exists because a public repo named rappvision-* with a channel.json at its root IS a RAPP Vision channel — creating it was the publish. Follow @kody-w in the player and this channel joined with no PR and no URL pasting.

videos.title: Summon 01 — Verify the seal, then roar
videos.description:
THE PROMPT — run it verbatim against kody-w/rappid:

    Verify my claude rappid's seal and burned-in birthday, then roar its cry.

WHAT THE ROOM SEES: The seal re-check passes on screen and the machine answers with the creature's unique synthesized call.

WHY IT LANDS: Identity is keyless and permanent — the proof is a hash you can re-check, not an account.

videos.title: Summon 05 — A chime earned from real work
videos.description:
THE PROMPT — run it verbatim against kody-w/rappid:

    My claude rappid just shipped this commit — let it earn a success chime from it. Anchor the mutation to HEAD, then show me its frames timeline.

WHAT THE ROOM SEES: The creature's sound grows from the work it did; frames show birth → mutation with the commit as provenance.

WHY IT LANDS: Frames, not snapshots: the current form is a deterministic fold over what it lived.

videos.title: Summon 06 — The reunion molt
videos.description:
THE PROMPT — run it verbatim against kody-w/rappid:

    Prove the reunion molt: export claude's egg, evolve the copy differently in an isolated RAPP_HOME, evolve the original here, then reunite them and diff the two folds.

WHAT THE ROOM SEES: Two copies that diverged offline come out byte-identical after the molt.

WHY IT LANDS: Neither side loses what it learned alone. Union the frames, re-fold, done.

WHY IT LANDS: Any AI becomes a RAPP/1 wire-conformant creature in one command.

videos.title: Summon 08 — The party walks off the laptop
videos.description:
THE PROMPT — run it verbatim against kody-w/rappid:

    Export my party as a QR I can scan right now.

WHAT THE ROOM SEES: A QR appears, a phone scans it, and the six-creature party heads into the field.

WHY IT LANDS: Field transfer is a file, not a service — AirDrop it, scan it, reassimilate on return.

videos.title: Summon 09 — Seven words, empty home
videos.description:
THE PROMPT — run it verbatim against kody-w/rappid:

    Wipe a fresh RAPP_HOME and summon: dogg summon alder-ivy-juniper-wharf-yarrow-dusk-vessel

WHAT THE ROOM SEES: From an empty home, seven spoken words self-assemble the creature from raw public GitHub, byte-verified, under its original identity.

WHY IT LANDS: Resurrection with no account, no key, no server. This is the federation working.

videos.description:
